result_summary.title: SSO Integration Module returning empty responses and rate limit errors (APAC Staging)
result_summary.description: In the APAC staging environment, the SSO Integration Module is behaving inconsistently. We are observing two main symptoms: the API occasionally returns an empty response body, and we are hitting rate limit exceeded errors. This is affecting approximately 23 users who are unable to complete their authentication flows. The moderate business impact is due to blocked testing activities. It is unclear if the empty responses are related to the rate limiting or if they are a separate serialization issue. Please investigate the correlation between these two symptoms.
